metadata.description: Catalog of ComfyUI ecosystem packages and their maintenance status

packages.name: ComfyUI-Manager
packages.role_summary: Primary distribution mechanism for custom node packs; provides custom-node-list.json for discovery and Manager UI for install/update/remove

packages.name: ComfyUI Registry
packages.role_summary: Official package registry that backs the new Manager UI install experience; packages registered here surface cleanly in the modern Manager UI

packages.name: ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
packages.role_summary: Detector, Detailer, Upscaler, Pipe, and hook-provider nodes; the reference implementation of bundle-pipe datatypes in the community
notable_patterns: extensive use of composition patterns for schedule and detailer hooks
packages.used_by: Large workflows involving image enhancement, face restoration, and inpainting pipelines

packages.name: comfyui_controlnet_aux
packages.role_summary: Control and preprocessing node pack with 30+ annotator-backed preprocessors, an AIO preprocessor entry point, and structured pose output patterns that are useful for extension and API integration study.
notable_patterns: structured OpenPose and DWPose JSON outputs
packages.used_by: Workflows that depend on ControlNet preprocessing, pose extraction, and reusable annotator wrappers
packages.caveats: Research confidence: HIGH. Community-observed package; verify current upstream state before depending on it.

packages.name: ComfyUI-AnimateDiff-Evolved
packages.role_summary: Video and animation node pack that extends motion-module sampling with sliding context windows, keyframe scheduling, and batch latent manipulation for temporally coherent generation.
packages.used_by: Animation workflows that need motion-module scheduling and temporal coherence controls inside ComfyUI
packages.caveats: Research confidence: HIGH. Community-observed package; verify current upstream state before depending on it.

packages.name: ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite
packages.role_summary: Video I/O and batch utility node pack that wraps ffmpeg with JSON-defined codec profiles and adds reusable latent and image batch helpers for animation pipelines.
packages.used_by: Animation and video workflows that need video export, import, and batch manipulation utilities around core ComfyUI graphs
packages.caveats: Research confidence: HIGH. Community-observed package; verify current upstream state before depending on it.

packages.name: WAS Node Suite
packages.role_summary: Over 200 nodes covering image processing, masking, text handling, arithmetic, and video operations
packages.used_by: General ComfyUI users needing utility nodes
packages.caveats: A replacement pack provided for existing users following retirement of the original author; maintained by the community

packages.name: Efficiency Nodes
packages.role_summary: Streamlined workflow nodes that reduce total node count; useful for simplifying complex graphs
packages.used_by: Users building large or repetitive workflows

packages.name: ProfilerX
packages.role_summary: Runtime monitoring extension that listens to execution events and exposes per-node timing metrics through a frontend panel
notable_patterns: hybrid extension combining server hooks, frontend hooks, and custom routes for metrics display
packages.used_by: Referenced as the canonical example of runtime monitoring in the extensions patterns page

packages.name: ComfyUI-Tooling-Nodes
packages.role_summary: Extension-owned HTTP routes for cached image transfer, model inspection, and translation helpers; /api/etn/... routes that serve external tooling while ComfyUI handles generation
notable_patterns: tool-facing extension routes combined with normal ComfyUI prompt execution
